risks: model ranking does not hold across windows
series is close to noise; fitted weights would overfit
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~16% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The spectrum is close to white noise, so most of the variation is irregular and hard to predict. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (1 points, ~1% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.111), which favours a robust combination.

The series has very unstable ranking (tau 0.111) and many correlated groups; a simple inverse‑error weighting may give more balanced influence than softmax.
The series has very high trend and seasonality but unstable rankings; a trimmed mean may reduce influence of outlier models while keeping robust.
test a simple mean of all models to see if a flat average beats robust central tendency in this weak, high‑outlier series.
test a DBA strategy on the full pool to see if a dynamic weighted average improves over median under unstable rankings.
Test a per‑horizon one‑hot weighting to exploit the very strong seasonality and the fact that different clusters dominate at different steps.
test a weighted combination using the per‑horizon top‑k mean (w5) to see if per‑horizon averaging improves over the robust median, given the unstable ranking and many correlated groups.
Test a weighted combination on the reduced, low‑error pool to see if a focused subset beats the robust median on the full pool.
The series shows high outliers and unstable ranking; using a robust pool (pool4) with a smooth softmax weighting may reduce overfitting compared to full pool.

decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9389. Series context: trend strength 0.9958 and seasonal strength 0.9992; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.111); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.413.
